text:
maria: Heads-up — auditor just asked for a compact evidence bundle showing a recent RBAC change, related approval artifacts, and proof that KMS key rotation didn't break decrypts. Need to scope what we hand to them.

sam: Can we get specific timeframe? auditor asked for 'last 90 days' but we should confirm exact window.

auditor: confirm please — we need: (1) list of role changes + diffs, (2) who approved each change (ticket/PR), (3) audit logs showing access that used those roles, (4) KMS rotation manifest and successful decrypt test runs. 90 days ok.

maria: 90 days works. Priority: tie each role-change to an approval artifact. Also include compact log samples, not raw gigabytes.

alex: For logs, we can provide filtered Splunk export plus a small replayable sample. I'll include queries. Example query to pull role-change events:```source=cloudtrail eventName=UpdateRole OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy | stats count by userIdentity.principalId, eventName, requestParameters.roleName, _time```

sam: For KMS rotation: we have rotation records in KMS audit table and an automated decrypt-check lambda we ran post-rotation. I'll package the rotation manifest and the lambda run logs. Sample lambda command:```aws lambda invoke --function-name verify-kms-rotation --payload '{"keyId":"alias/redwood-main","testCiphertext":"<blob>"}' out.json```

alex: Sample log snippet (sanitized):```2025-07-03T12:05:34Z INFO user=svc-deploy role=deploy-admin action=UpdateRole roleName=frontend-worker requestId=abcd-1234```

jess: Checklist for packaging (SOC2/ISO):
- control crosswalk mapping (control ID -> artifacts)
- RBAC diff csv + PR links
- Approval emails/tickets (redacted)
- Filtered audit logs (csv + small raw samples)
- KMS rotation manifest + decrypt test outputs
- Timeline & README to explain mapping

maria: I'll own the crosswalk README. Sam, can you produce the PR->role diff mapping? Alex, can you export the Splunk filtered CSV and the 1-hour replay sample. Jess, can you confirm redaction policy for emails.

sam: On it. I'll script the diff extraction from git history and infra-as-code. Example output row: `2025-05-02T15:10Z, iam/roles/frontend-worker, change=inline_policy_modified, pr=https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/142`

alex: Splunk export ETA ~2 hours. For the replay, I'm going to pull a condensed stream with only role-change + assume-role events for the sample session. Command I used:```splunk search "index=infra action=AssumeRole OR action=UpdateRole" | outputcsv rbac_sample.csv```

jess: Redaction: remove user emails, replace with `uid:xxxx` mapping file included separately. We can include PR URLs but redact author emails. We need to note in README what was redacted.

maria: Auditor also asked for evidence of incident triage workflow being followed for any suspicious role changes. Query for alerts and any incident tickets referencing the role names.

sam: We have one suspicious spike on 2025-06-11 where an external CI job attempted an UpdateRole and failed MFA. I will include the incident ticket (INT-321) and truncated debug logs.

alex: Putting together a small forensic playback for that incident — sanitized timeline and the observability trace link (internal only). We'll include a screenshot timeline + exported trace spans.

auditor: For the incident, we need: timeline, who initiated response, actions taken, and confirmation that keys weren't exfiltrated. A short statement from the oncall lead is fine.

oncall-bot: @maria assign INT-321 to maria for evidence packaging (due 2025-07-10) :white_check_mark:

maria: Noted. Plan to produce a single tarball: `evidence_bundle_2025-07-09.tar.gz` with: `crosswalk.csv`, `rbac_diffs.csv`, `pr_links.txt` (redacted), `logs/` (filtered CSVs + sample.log), `kms/rotation_manifest.json`, `kms/decrypt_tests.out`, `incident/INT-321.md`, `README.md`.

sam: One more ask from auditor: show you can reproduce successful decrypt with previous and rotated key version in a controlled test. I'll include the test script and outputs.

alex: FYI: we should avoid shipping any private key material. Only include KMS metadata + decrypt success outputs. No ciphertexts that could be abused.

jess: I'll draft the cover note for SOC2 auditor referencing control mapping: A.9 (access control), A.12 (logs), and crypto key management section.

maria: Great. Timeline: artifacts ready by 2025-07-09, packaging + redaction done by 2025-07-10, upload to auditor SFTP by 2025-07-11. Any blockers?

sam: None from infra. Just need alex to confirm exports completed.

alex: Exports done, packaging in progress. Will ping when tarball is ready.

auditor: Thanks team — please include MD5 checksum and manifest with file sizes. Also add a short note describing sampling rationale for logs (why we didn't include full raw logs).

maria: Will do. Adding that to README.

sam: I'll follow up with a quick PR linking the scripts we used to generate artifacts so auditor can verify processes.

maria: Perfect. If anything unexpected pops up, @channel ping me. :handshake:
